title: FormalState
description: One exact Lean state in a proof's search graph (Section 5.9). The exact_state_hash identifies the concrete target/context under a pinned environment and serialization version; the semantic_signature is a normalized-similarity key that may only *propose* transpositions. They are separate required fields by design: equal semantics never merge states, and no field here carries truth -- only Lean replay can close a state.

state_id.description: Allocator-issued ID scoped to the proof, e.g. 'p1/fs-1'.

goal_text.description: The concrete Lean target as elaborated.

exact_state_hash.description: Hash over goal_text + context + environment identity + serialization_version. Identity, never similarity.

semantic_signature.description: Normalized similarity key. May propose transpositions only; never merges or closes states.

annotations.description: Scheduling features only. A state carrying scores is not one step closer to being true.
